scope: Cellular automata, evolutionary music, multi-agent composition, stigmergy, self-organization, and bio-inspired computation

records.title: MusicSwarm: Biologically Inspired Intelligence for Music Composition
records.claim: A decentralized swarm of frozen foundation-model agents is reported to produce coherent long-form music through shared signals and consensus without weight updates.

records.title: Musical agents: A typology and state of the art towards Musical Metacreation
records.claim: A typology of 78 musical-agent systems maps roles and tasks in musical metacreation.
limits: Review reflects surveyed systems and publication period

records.title: Biologically-Inspired and Agent-Based Algorithms for Music
records.claim: Biological and ecological models offer approaches to emergent, adaptive, agent-based music making.
limits: Scholarly synthesis, not a controlled comparison

records.title: Generative Music with Partitioned Quantum Cellular Automata
records.claim: Cellular automata can generate musical material by evolving local states and mapping patterns into sound.

records.title: Artificial Life Music: An A-Life Approach to Generating Melodies Featuring Genetic Algorithms
records.claim: An implementation combines L-systems, cellular automata, and genetic algorithms for melody generation.

records.title: Evolutionary music: applying evolutionary computation to the art of creating music
records.claim: Evolutionary approaches support varied musical tasks; no single method or fitness function is best for all composition.
limits: Review scope and methods vary by task

records.title: At the crossroads of evolutionary computation and music: self-programming synthesizers, swarm orchestras and the origins of melody
records.claim: Evolutionary computation has engineering, compositional, and musicological applications in music.
limits: Historical survey and examples; not current generative AI

records.title: Creative DNA computing: splicing systems for music composition
records.claim: DNA-inspired splicing systems can be applied to four-part composition and jazz solo generation.
limits: Few practical systems in the literature

records.title: Computational Creativity and Music Generation Systems: An Introduction to the State of the Art
records.claim: Music-generation systems use diverse procedural approaches, each with different structures and open challenges.

evidence_policy: Preserve evidence class and scope. Treat claims about system performance as study-specific. Do not infer Suno architecture or prompt semantics from external generative systems.
